journey.title: Journey
journey.lead: From law to fashion. From a literary baccalaureate in Yamoussoukro to a couture house celebrated for its boldness. An uncommon path — that of a woman who refuses to be boxed in.
journey.chapter_1_text: It all begins in Yamoussoukro. A brilliant literary track student, she earns her BAC A. Already the writing, already the word, already this urge to tell — through words or through fabric.
journey.chapter_2_title: Master's in Law · Path to magistracy
journey.chapter_2_text: Heading toward law. Master's degree in hand, she steps onto the demanding path to the bench. Discipline, rigor, critical thinking — another kind of couture, the couture of files.
journey.chapter_3_text: The runway calls. Model and figure, she learns the light, the gesture, the silhouette — everything her dresses will one day say. Fashion is no longer a hobby, it's a language.
journey.chapter_4_label: Chapter IV · The hand that creates
journey.chapter_4_text: The designer takes over. She founds Marie Koffi Confection — a house where African heritage meets contemporary cuts. Every piece, handmade, tells a woman's story.
journey.chapter_5_text: Recently crowned — a victory that seals this remarkable path. Recognition of a vision: that of a designer who dares everything, and does it with elegance.
journey.quote: You don't leave the law. You dress it differently.
journey.cta_lead: Every creation is designed for the woman who will wear it. Let's tell yours.

about.title: About
about.lead: Marie Koffi is an Ivorian stylist and designer. Her couture house offers handmade pieces in the pure tradition of bespoke tailoring.
about.p1: Founded with the will to celebrate modern African elegance, Marie Koffi Confection is more than a brand: it is a vision. A vision where wax fabric, traditional textiles, and contemporary cuts come together to create unique silhouettes.
about.p2: Every creation is treated as an exceptional piece, handmade in our Abidjan workshops. Whether you are looking for a ceremony gown, a traditional outfit, or a ready-to-wear set, we design clothing that reflects who you are.
about.value_1_text: Every piece is tailored to your body, your taste, and the occasion.
about.value_2_text: Artisanal craftsmanship, selected fabrics, refined finishings.
about.value_3_text: Inspired by the richness of West African textiles.
